items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I remember him, I used to read about him, Bubba Miley with Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: Yes, Bubba Miley. Now I didn't know Bubba. See Bubba was just a little before my time. He passed on quite early, I guess it was early '30s, I don't recall, but I remember him, I used to read about him, Bubba Miley with Duke Ellington. He died early in the early '30s if I'm not mistaken.
